_comment: Collision environment for the UFACTORY Lite 6.
The fence is expressed in metres from the world origin, which sits at the
robot base. The Lite 6 has a 440 mm reach, so these bounds leave a small
margin around the fully extended arm without clipping it.
mesh_list and box_list are intentionally empty: the cell furniture defined
for the DENSO and Staubli cells does not apply to this robot. Add the real
obstacles here once the Lite 6 is mounted in its cell.
